prompt:
Act as an expert full-stack developer and create a production-ready, beautiful newsletter publishing platform clone of Substack using Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and PostgreSQL (via Drizzle ORM). The application must feature a breathtaking, modern user interface utilizing glassmorphism, smooth micro-animations (using Framer Motion), and a meticulously crafted design system using rich, harmonious colors and premium typography (like Inter or Lora). The UI must feel incredibly premium, readable, and responsive.

Core Features & Functionality:
1. Public Publication Surface: A stunning, highly optimized public-facing site with a hero section to capture email subscribers using a beautifully designed double-opt-in form. Implement a highly polished reading experience for published posts with elegant typography, reading progress bars, and social sharing links.
2. Rich Text Editor: Build a robust, distraction-free markdown/rich-text editor for composing newsletter posts. Implement live preview to see exactly how the email and web post will look.
3. Subscriber Management: A dedicated admin view to list, filter, and manage subscribers. Implement subscriber import, double opt-in, unsubscribe handling, suppression, tags, and consent timestamps. Ensure CSV export functionality.
4. Email Delivery Engine: Queue sends through Amazon SES or Postmark via `.env` keys. Implement retries, rate limits, idempotency, and resumable batches. Process delivery, bounce, complaint, open, and click webhooks accurately.
5. Creator Dashboard: A sophisticated dashboard to manage the publication, view basic delivery statistics, and configure publication settings. 

Technical Architecture & Best Practices:
- Frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. Use shadcn/ui for accessible, highly polished foundation components.
- Backend & DB: Next.js Route Handlers with strict Zod validation. PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM.
- Compliance & Deliverability: Every email must flawlessly include a one-click unsubscribe link (no login required) and proper List-Unsubscribe headers.
- SEO & Performance: Implement automatic meta tags, semantic HTML5, localized loading states, and flawless error boundaries.

Implementation Requirements:
Start from an empty repository and build the complete working project. Store all user data locally by default and ensure straightforward data export. Put all secrets in `.env` and ship a `.env.example`. 

Deliverables:
Provide the full, deployable codebase. Include a detailed `README.md` covering setup, architecture, database migrations, SES/webhook configuration, and vital DNS homework (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) for deliverability. Write focused unit tests for the core data model. Deliberately exclude: ad sales, payment infrastructure (paid subscriptions), and newsletter recommendation marketplaces. Focus relentlessly on delivering a flawless, visually spectacular writing and reading experience.
